artifact: Disposition of the alternate Claude-authored HA packet

packet_artifacts.location: outside the repository; delivered to the owner as downloadable ZIPs

reason: The project owner has designated a different 60-case Codex derivative, reviewed by Grok Expert and by ChatGPT, as the packet of record for final GOLD-001 admission, and has stated that this 64-case packet is excluded from that compilation to avoid double-counting.
reason_provenance: Recorded from the owner's instruction in this session. The master packet Production_RAG_v1_Full_150_Case_Review.pdf was not available in this environment, so its text was not read and is not cited here as if it had been.

namespace_collision.finding: the two packets share the HA-nn namespace and are not the same cases
evidence: the alternate packet holds 64 drafts, HA-01 … HA-64; the packet of record holds 60
36 of the 60 reviewed cases (HA-25 … HA-60) do not correspond to any case in the alternate packet; question-text similarity to the same-numbered alternate case is below 0.61 for every one of them

HA-47 differs outright: the packet of record's HA-47 is the handoff `input_type` non-effect fact in ver_1c77f33b04ffffa285ea7e61c2a89653; the alternate packet's HA-47 is a DefaultAsyncHttpx2Client preference fact in ver_de67d790db9792b2f6c5c7418a507764
HA-01 … HA-24 do describe the same 24 facts in both packets, 18 of them at >0.85 question-text similarity — which is exactly why a short-id import would look plausible and be wrong
namespace_collision.consequence: No candidate from the 64-case packet may be substituted into the final 150, and no owner decision addressed to HA-01 … HA-60 may be applied to it.
